title: Dave (TV series)
premise_summary: Dave is an American television sitcom that premiered on FXX on March 4, 2020. It was co-created by rapper/comedian Dave Burd, who plays the titular character, and Jeff Schaffer. Kevin Hart and Greg Mottola form part of the production team. Lil Dicky's real-life hype man, GaTa, co-stars as himself. On May 11, 2020, the series was renewed for a second season, which premiered on June 16, 2021. On February 17, 2022, FXX renewed the series for a third season, which premiered on April 5, 2023. On February 1, 2024, FX announced that there were no current plans to renew the series while Burd pursues other projects.
